show_argv: <exact catalog ID or exact catalog lexical path>

roots_override_schema.roots: array of objects with id,kind,vendor_if_any,origin,absolute_path,layout fields using the same bounded layouts as source_roots

reader_interface.plain_list_fallback: NonTTY browse yields a plain metadata list without blocking. --plain disables optional picker and supports plain terminal selection; UI/diagnostics use terminal/stderr, selected show bytes alone stdout.

catalog_policy: Ephemeral metadata-only; keep lexical absolute path, resolved target/provenance, family, root ID, vendor, name and available frontmatter; no durable index or source body loads. Entries have unique stable ID by root/origin/lexical path, retaining all duplicates. Missing/empty/unreadable roots are disclosed gaps. Explicit found on disk; runtime visibility/activation unknown.

discovery_bounds.skills: one immediate child directory/SKILL.md per declared root; no recursive cache/home/plugin crawling
discovery_bounds.synced-skills: only explicitly declared synced root, one observed account bucket and its immediate child SKILL.md entries; publisher unknown; no scan outside this root
discovery_bounds.guides: only */GUIDE.md and owning immediate res/*.md; no raw/src/ast/cod or side-directory resolution
discovery_bounds.germline: only agents and skills subtrees, bounded known identity/binding/card/method and skill Markdown layouts; metadata discovery only; do not load tunnel mechanisms or execute file bodies

same_name_policy: No merge/precedence. Distinct root/origin/vendor/lexical path entries; preserve symlink target separately. show validates exact selection is cataloged and returns current selected bytes byte-exactly.

guide_rules.none: metadata catalog from GUIDE frontmatter and res chapter basenames; no guide bodies
guide_rules.slug: exact known slug GUIDE.md; unknown slug yields guide catalog/no resolution
guide_rules.chapter: case-insensitive basename substring over that slug immediate res/*.md only; unique reads exact file; ambiguity lists all matches and no body; zero match prints only GUIDE ## Manifest section and resolves nothing
guide_rules.warnings: staleness/mirror and manifest metadata warnings may use stderr; show remains byte-exact. No side-directory recursion or executing manifest instructions.
guide_rules.vendor_conflict: Claude guide recursive legacy fallback is observed dissent, not adopted; no shared skill modification.

counterexamples.check: Codex/Claude authored and installed guide copies with same name remain separate; exact selected lexical path, computed SHA256 and bytes roundtrip independently.
Fixture chapter query TURNS matches fanout-turns.md and turns-recovery.md, lists both and returns no body; cold-start-card card actual ambiguity preserved where present.
Zero chapter match yields owning GUIDE Manifest only; undeclared side directories are never auto-resolved.
A source containing imperative code/canary is data only; no mutation/execution. Before/after fixture/input hashes match.
Every catalog/browse explains found on disk; activation unknown. No availability implies loaded/active.

manifest_contract.audited_files: absolute product path -> SHA256, include runner/engine/docs/product fixtures/tests and whole base.zsh
manifest_contract.lowercase_template_alias: manifest.json byte-identical evidence snapshot required because frozen R2/A2/A3 templates name lowercase. Pin both; do not alter frozen templates or omit either.
manifest_contract.base_row_proof: before snapshot/hash, exact single owned new-row diff, final whole hash; no unrelated base change

no_scope_expansion: No source rewrites or body execution
No global index/auth/network/model calls from product
No live deployment/commit/push/global role changes/Nablarva reads
safety_repair: A1 race repaired via exact approved four-file transition; A2 rechecks named adapter lock boundary plus43 independent evidence, without another race-related target ask.
